mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wf_task WHERE status = 'PENDING'
SELECT AVG(duration) FROM wf_process_monitor WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND end_time IS NOT NULL AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) / CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) * 100 FROM wf_process_monitor WHERE status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'TERMINATED') AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT p.id, p.instance_id, p.process_def_id, p.process_def_key, p.process_def_name as process_name, p.status, p.start_time, p.end_time, COALESCE(p.duration, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, p.start_time, NOW()) * 1000) as duration_ms, p.task_count, p.task_count as completed_task_count, p.start_user_name as initiator, p.start_user_name as initiator_name, p.create_time FROM wf_process_monitor p WHERE p.instance_id = #{instanceId}

SELECT p.id, p.instance_id, p.process_def_id, p.process_def_key, p.process_def_name as process_name, p.status, p.start_time, p.end_time, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, p.start_time, NOW()) * 1000 as duration_ms, p.task_count, p.task_count as completed_task_count, p.start_user_name as initiator, p.start_user_name as initiator_name, p.create_time FROM wf_process_monitor p WHERE p.status = 'RUNNING' AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY p.start_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.instance_id, p.process_def_id, p.process_def_key, p.process_def_name as process_name, p.status, p.start_time, p.end_time, COALESCE(p.duration, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, p.start_time, NOW()) * 1000) as duration_ms, p.task_count, p.task_count as completed_task_count, p.start_user_name as initiator, p.start_user_name as initiator_name, p.create_time FROM wf_process_monitor p WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.process_def_key = #{processDefKey} ORDER BY p.start_time DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
